newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers slip, buying also stays low.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers slip, buying also stays low.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers sagged as demand remained poor and barges dropped, while weaker cargo quotes brought down Mediterranean bunker prices.
Rotterdam bunker dropped to around $83 fob as barges lost $1/$2 a tonne.
Total ARA bunker volumes remained low, at little more than 10,000 tonnes, which partly explained the weaker market.
"The enquiries were low in the morning, slightly increased in the afternoon, but not enough to increase prices," one supplier said.
Hamburg bunkers were stable as a number of enquiries seemed set to emerge for the weekend.
Mediterranean prices were down on average $2 for both fuel oil and gas oil.
Only French ports resisted the dip as demand mounted.
Dealers said that fuel oil supplies would be tight for the next week as oil companies had oversold. Some quoted as high as $99-$100 while the shortage lasted.
